newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Nail may bid for Metlife shares.
newsitem.headline: Nail may bid for Metlife shares.

text.p: New Africa Investment Ltd said on Thursday it was in talks which could result in an offer being made by Nail to Metropolitan Life Ltd ordinary shareholders to acquire their shares.
Last May, Nail disposed of its 29.5 percent stake in Metlife.

Sankorp Ltd and New Africa Finance Holdings Ltd (Nafhold), involved in negotiations with Nail, also made the joint cautionary announcement which advised shareholders in Nail, Nafhold and Metlife to take care in their dealings.
The announcement said that, should Nail acquire Metlife shares it would be in consideration for which new Nail "N" shares would be issued.
"Should the... transaction occur the interests of the ordinary shareholders of Nail and Nafhold would also be affected," it said.
